description: Presidential Secretariat - The Commission of Inquiry enlarge the Period 21st July 2021 and once again enlarge the Period 31st March, 2023
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of a deadline for a Commission of Inquiry to render its final report, which is a legal/regulatory matter under the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393). It involves statutory powers and procedures rather than government personnel changes, organisational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
